purpose: Review a finite Campaign112 catalog against the complete v73 mechanism and source-semantic frontier before reading any Campaign112 source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price, or forward return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_cross_sectional_return_rank_breadth_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: At each of the 238 within-half return positions, average-tie percentile-rank every stock against the same-clock cross-section, then average one stock's 238 ranks.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign063 explicitly rejected cross-sectional percentile-rank state operators before values, and the frozen market-neutral drift, market sign, and relative-state families already consume the same synchronous peer-return information. Replacing the frozen z-state or residual statistic with a same-clock Borda average after their results is an operator rescue, not a new source state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_one_tick_bid_ask_bounce_resilience_236p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Reward the absence of consecutive opposite-signed exact one-CNY-0.01-tick raw-close moves inside each half session.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign104 already rejected conditioning the exposed raw tick-grid state on adjacent price updates. Adding a two-transition reversal operator further recombines the terminal reversal-energy, direction-continuity, and tick-grid families after exposure; aggregate minute closes do not identify quoted bid-ask states.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_rolling_20_session_clock_profile_surprise_238b
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Compare the current 238-position return profile with a same-stock, same-clock baseline estimated from the preceding 20 accepted stock sessions.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The accepted minute snapshot begins in 2019, so an exact 20-session history creates a deterministic early-sample cold start already prohibited by the known-support gate. It also replaces the frozen exact-prior-session profile mechanisms with a selected rolling estimator and lookback after their results were observed.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: accepted_instrument_continuous_trading_streak_20s
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Reset a capped 20-session continuity clock whenever a stock has no accepted market-session observation and rank the post-gap seasoning state higher.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A missing minute stock-session is not an accepted point-in-time suspension event: it may reflect suspension, source omission, incomplete coverage, listing boundary, or delisting. Ranking that absence would turn a fail-closed data/eligibility state into a favorable or unfavorable factor without an accepted suspension-history source. It also behaves as an execution eligibility gate rather than a cross-sectional return mechanism.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.required_new_semantics_if_revisited: A separately fingerprinted point-in-time exchange suspension/resumption source that distinguishes true suspension from provider absence before any factor row.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: full_numeric_library_tree_interaction_model_134f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_formula: Fit a nonlinear tree interaction model on all 134 frozen-direction numeric components inside each expanding training fold.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign102 already consumed the separately frozen supervised complete-library family, and Campaign103/v73 explicitly forbid changing model, target, component treatment, reweighting, or interaction architecture as a retry. A tree now would select interactions after observing the bounded-simplex and later complete-library failures.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: tushare_top_list_recent_event_intensity
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The only accepted local top_list evidence is one completed-session entitlement sample whose raw table contains exact duplicates and remains pending event-time alignment and canonicalization. It is not a 2019-2025 point-in-time source and cannot support a historical formula, capacity gate, or walk-forward trial. Creating a full source would require a separate pre-row contract and provider workflow, which Campaign112 does not authorize.

frontier_conclusion.reason: The proposed remaining transforms are post-exposure recombinations of a 140-definition library; another operator sweep would increase multiplicity without adding an identified state.
frontier_conclusion.next_research_domain: Only a separately accepted point-in-time source state not represented by aggregate minute OHLCV/amount, daily turnover, quarterly fields, or prior terminal event sources.
